info.title: Kibamail API
info.description: API for managing contacts, campaigns, and email marketing operations

post.description: Create a new API key for workspace authentication

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of contacts using cursor-based pagination

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of contacts to return (default: 20, max: 100)

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor for pagination - ID of the last contact from the previous page

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor for reverse pagination - ID of the first contact from the next page

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key, or insufficient scopes
